title: Enterprise DevOps: GitOps, Change-Aware CI/CD & K8s Incident Post-Mortem
description: A real-world engineering case study covering zero-K8s local dev contracts, change-aware Jenkins CI pipelines, ArgoCD GitOps reconciliation, and production K8s NetworkPolicy debugging.
objectives: Design zero-Kubernetes reproducible local development with Makefile & Docker Compose
Implement change-aware CI pipelines with security scanning and build matrix skipping
Configure GitOps CD reconciliation with ArgoCD, Harbor, and Kustomize overlays
Troubleshoot stuck Init:1/2 containers and K8s NetworkPolicy label mismatches
